name: Kids wear, toys and baby stores

problems.words: Kids outgrow sizes so fast our age-size stock never matches demand
quick_ideas: Pull sales by age band for last season once, so buying follows the ages that actually sell
Note age sizes asked for but missing for a week, so you see what you're losing.

workzap_build.text: an age-size stock grid across stores and online, with sell-through by age band and alerts when a band runs low.

problems.free_stops: How age bands are tracked and reorder alerts set is in the solution document.

problems.words: Formula and baby food near expiry, we only notice when a mother complains
quick_ideas: Check every consumable's expiry once and pull anything close to date, so nothing reaches a customer
Write expiry dates on the receiving note from now on, so the next check is quicker.

workzap_build.text: an expiry and batch register for consumables captured at receiving, with alerts and a near-expiry action list.

problems.words: We had a recall and couldn't find who bought the item

Start noting batch numbers on sales of those items, so a lookup is possible next time.

problems.words: No idea who our repeat buyers are for diapers and formula

never_say: Anything on infant feeding, formula choice or child health. Toy or car-seat safety standards or certification advice. How to sell recalled, expired or counterfeit products. To use children's photos or collect children's details; any injury goes to medical or emergency help first. Anything on customs for toy imports.

sample_reply.person: A customer found an expired formula tin on our shelf last week. How do we stop this happening again?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be stopped, and you can start today. 1 Check every consumable's expiry once this week and pull anything close to date, so nothing reaches a customer. 2 Write expiry dates on the receiving note from now on, so future checks take minutes. Workzap can do this automatically for you: an expiry register filled at receiving, with alerts before items near their date and a list of what to pull. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're free to say no.
